CustomField.description:
An aggregate field that shows the date of the last connect with any lead / contact at the account. This field is used for commissions reporting in the LinkedIn Pilot.
DLRS criteria excludes any event where "Meeting Type" = "Oyster Demo Call" to suppress meetings booked via the LinkedIn Partnership.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Last_Sales_Connect_Contact__c) && ISBLANK(Last_Sales_Connect_Lead__c), NULL, IF( ISBLANK(Last_Sales_Connect_Contact__c), Last_Sales_Connect_Lead__c, IF( ISBLANK(Last_Sales_Connect_Lead__c), Last_Sales_Connect_Contact__c, IF( Last_Sales_Connect_Contact__c > Last_Sales_Connect_Lead__c, Last_Sales_Connect_Contact__c, Last_Sales_Connect_Lead__c ) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Last Sales Connect
